brief.industry_meta: Defence Technology · Autonomous Systems / Lattice Software
brief.deck: Anduril, the Costa Mesa defence-technology company that already sponsors NASCAR and Hendrick Motorsports, announced a $5B Series H at a $61B valuation on 13 May 2026, doubling its price in a year, weeks before its first NASCAR title race and the start of production at its $1B Ohio factory.
brief.the_case_p1: On 13 May 2026 Anduril announced a $5B Series H led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz at a $61B valuation, double the $30.5B set in June 2025, taking total funding past $11B over eight rounds. The demand behind it is public: the US Army awarded a ten-year enterprise contract with a $20B ceiling on 13 March 2026, and Arsenal-1, a $1B factory in Columbus, Ohio, targets production from July. Anduril has bought motorsport already: Official Defense Partner of NASCAR, title sponsor of June's San Diego weekend at Naval Base Coronado, and Hendrick's William Byron through 2028.
brief.the_case_p2: That NASCAR programme is the tell. A company that put a Cup Series event on a naval base to recruit engineers and tell a rebuild-the-arsenal story has a template Formula 1 can scale: three US rounds, a global engineering audience and a listing expected in 2027. General Motors is the bridge. GM Defense signed a teaming agreement with Anduril in October 2023 on autonomy and electrification, and Cadillac is GM's works team.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The round closed on 13 May; the NASCAR debut at Coronado is in June and Arsenal-1 starts production in July, so budget, motorsport template and manufacturing story crest together. The United States GP in Austin (October) and the Las Vegas GP (November) fall inside the window; 2027 rosters close in the fourth quarter.
brief.why_team_para: Cadillac is General Motors' American works entry, in its first season with a deliberately small roster: TWG AI, Core Scientific, IFS, Tenneco, Jim Beam, Tommy Hilfiger, Claro. No aerospace, defence or autonomy partner is on it, and the parent already works with Anduril through GM Defense, so the introduction is warm on both sides. Three US rounds give a Costa Mesa brand home stages, and a debut team prices entry below the established grid.
brief.value_content: MODE B - halo with concrete mechanics. TWG AI holds Cadillac's exclusive AI lane, so this is not a software workstream. It is: livery and garage presence at Miami, Austin and Las Vegas; engineering-recruitment content, the job Anduril's marketing chief says marketing does, filmed at Arsenal-1 and the team's Indiana headquarters; warfighter-family programmes carried over from the Hendrick deal; hospitality for Pentagon, Congressional and allied guests at the US rounds.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Defence Technology Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, bridging the Hendrick term and a probable listing. Estimated $8-12M a year, the top of Cadillac's partner tier. Scope: engine-cover or rear-wing placement, US-round hospitality, recruitment and manufacturing content, a joint GM Defense and Cadillac engineering story.
brief.decision_maker_bio: Anduril's first marketing chief, hired in May 2024 from Cruise, where he was VP of marketing, after Snapchat, PepsiCo and Ogilvy; he built the NASCAR and Hendrick programmes. Path: Matthew Steckman, President and Chief Business Officer; Matt Grimm, Co-Founder and COO; Brian Schimpf, CEO.
brief.opening_angle_quote: “Jeff, you put a Cup Series event on a naval base. Formula 1 gives you Austin, Las Vegas and Miami, a global engineering audience, and GM's own works team, whose parent already works with you. 25 minutes before Austin to size the Cadillac lane?”
score_cells: Round 13 May; NASCAR debut June; Arsenal-1 July; Austin and Las Vegas in window.
$5B raise at $61B; more than $11B raised; $20B Army contract ceiling.
Proven motorsport buyer; American engineering story; defence sensitivities.
Listing expected 2027; 2027 rosters close in Q4; Hendrick term runs to 2028.
MODE B: halo with recruitment and US-round mechanics; AI lane held by TWG.
risks: A weapons maker on a Formula 1 car will draw scrutiny from teams, promoters and a European fan base NASCAR did not test.
Lead with the Boeing-at-Alpine precedent and Cadillac's American identity; agree product-imagery rules up front.
TWG AI is Cadillac's exclusive AI partner and Anduril's Lattice is AI software; the lane must be defence technology, not AI.
Define the lane as defence and autonomous systems and clear it with TWG before the first call.
brief.bottom_line: A $5B round at $61B, a $20B Army contract ceiling, a factory starting in July and a NASCAR programme already running put Anduril at peak brand-investment authority with a proven appetite for motorsport. GM Defense gives a warm path into Cadillac, the defence lane on the grid is open and two US races remain inside the window.

why_now.label: Trigger
why_now.text: On 13 May 2026 Anduril announced a $5B Series H led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz at a $61B valuation, double the $30.5B set by the $2.5B round of June 2025; total funding is now more than $11B over eight rounds. The company announced the round itself and Bloomberg, TechCrunch and GovConWire carried it the same day. Revenue is not disclosed and the brief uses no revenue figure.

why_now.label: The demand behind the price
why_now.text: The US Army awarded Anduril a ten-year enterprise contract with a $20B ceiling on 13 March 2026, consolidating more than 120 procurement actions into one framework built around the Lattice software. The ceiling is a maximum, not an obligated amount, and the brief says so. Arsenal-1, the $1B hyperscale factory in Columbus, Ohio, targets production from July 2026.

why_now.label: Motorsport is already in the budget
why_now.text: Anduril is Official Defense Partner of NASCAR and presenting sponsor of the NASCAR San Diego weekend; the Anduril 250 'Race the Base' Cup Series street race ran at Naval Base Coronado on 21 June 2026. It is also a primary sponsor of Hendrick Motorsports' William Byron for two Cup races a season from 2026 through 2028. The question for Anduril is not whether to buy motorsport but whether to scale it to a global engineering audience.

why_now.label: Calendar window
why_now.text: The Miami GP has just run; the United States GP in Austin (October) and the Las Vegas GP (November) are the US rounds left in 2026, and teams close their 2027 partner rosters in the fourth quarter. A listing is expected by analysts in 2027 or later; a partnership agreed over the summer can be announced at Austin and run through the listing window.

why_team.label: The warm path
why_team.text: GM Defense, a General Motors subsidiary, signed a teaming agreement with Anduril in October 2023 on autonomy, battery electrification and new propulsion, and the two showed Infantry Squad Vehicles fitted with Anduril systems at AUSA that year. Cadillac F1 Team is General Motors' works entry. The introduction can run through a relationship both sides already value.

why_team.label: The open lane
why_team.text: Cadillac's debut roster is deliberately small: TWG AI as primary and exclusive AI partner, Core Scientific for data-centre infrastructure, IFS for enterprise software, Tenneco as technical partner, Jim Beam, Tommy Hilfiger and Claro. No aerospace, defence or autonomy partner is on it, and the team has said it is not seeking a title sponsor in year one, so a top-tier team partner is the largest seat on offer.

why_team.label: American identity, US stages
why_team.text: A Costa Mesa company that used a naval base for its first NASCAR event gets an American works team, an Indiana headquarters, and Miami, Austin and Las Vegas as home rounds. The 'rebuild the arsenal' story and Cadillac's American-engineering debut are the same story told twice.

why_team.label: Price of entry
why_team.text: A first-season team prices its partner tier below the established grid, and its inventory is not yet crowded. For a brand that spends on two Cup races a season with Hendrick, the step up to a three-year F1 seat is proportionate to a $5B raise.

value.label: Halo with concrete mechanics (Mode B)
value.text: TWG AI holds Cadillac's exclusive AI lane, so the brief does not claim a Lattice-on-the-pit-wall workstream. What Anduril brings is a brand that recruits engineers: co-produced content across Arsenal-1 and the Indiana headquarters, engineering-talent programmes with the team, and a manufacturing story that runs from a hyperscale factory to a race car built in the same country.

value.label: Commercial lift for the team
value.text: Anduril's guest list is Pentagon, Congressional, allied-government and prime-contractor audiences, plus the venture and public-market investors who priced the $61B round. Hospitality at Miami, Austin and Las Vegas puts that audience in Cadillac's suite alongside its other B2B partners.

value.label: Programmes that already exist
value.text: The Hendrick agreement carries warfighter and military-family programmes; the same mechanics translate to the US rounds, with GM Defense as a natural co-sponsor. Content from the Coronado event gives the team a template rather than a blank page.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Defence Technology Partner designation, engine-cover or rear-wing placement, US-round hospitality, driver and engineering access for recruitment content, and a joint GM Defense and Cadillac engineering story for Anduril's channels.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Jeff Miller before the United States GP to test the F1 step-up against the NASCAR programme, confirm the category definition with TWG AI, and size an Official Defence Technology Partner entry against Cadillac's 2027 roster.

# Anduril Industries → Cadillac F1 Team — verification log (N° 220, issued for 15 May 2026)

Built in-session on 6 Sep 2026 at no API cost (no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the sandbox) from a case spec
(`andurilindustries.case.json`) with Claude doing the research, verification and writing; the calendar
table, sponsor table, 13-rule audit and the 2-page render ran as code via `python -m intel.session_case`.
The row came from a thin scan dated 15 May 2026 (score 86, no team, person Palmer Luckey); the trigger
was corrected, the sponsorship owner re-identified and the score re-set.

**Sandbox limitation, stated plainly:** direct fetches of anduril.com, techcrunch.com, bloomberg.com,
army.mil, hendrickmotorsports.com, nascar.com, gmdefensellc.com, theorg.com and cadillacf1team.com were
blocked by the egress proxy. Each claim below was checked against the search summary of the primary page
named as the evidence URL. Treat every VERIFIED line as REPORTED until a person opens the link.
Confidence is MEDIUM and the footer reads VERIFY BEFORE CIRCULATION.

## The trigger, corrected

The thin row said "$5B financing round; prior $4B round Mar 2026 at a reported $60B valuation". The
round is real but the shape was wrong: **$5B Series H at a $61B valuation, announced 13 May 2026** (not
15 May), led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz; the **prior round was $2.5B at $30.5B in June
2025** — there was no $4B March 2026 round. The "$20B US Army contract" is confirmed as a ten-year
enterprise contract with a **$20B ceiling** (army.mil, 13 Mar 2026), a maximum rather than an obligated
amount. `signal_date` is 13 May; the row date 15 May is the run date. Inside the 90-day window.

## The finding the thin row missed

**Anduril already buys motorsport.** It is Official Defense Partner of NASCAR and presenting sponsor of
the NASCAR San Diego weekend (NASCAR, 14 Aug 2025); the Anduril 250 "Race the Base" Cup Series street
race ran at Naval Base Coronado on 21 June 2026; and it is a primary sponsor of Hendrick Motorsports'
William Byron for two Cup races a season 2026–2028 (Hendrick, 22 Oct 2025). None of this is F1 or FE,
so Anduril is not an existing grid partner, but it is the warmest signal class: a marketing chief who
has structured motorsport deals. `leadership_ties` therefore records **Jeff Miller — built the NASCAR
and Hendrick programmes (2025)**. No F1/FE tie was found for Schimpf, Steckman, Grimm, Stephens or
Luckey after checking.

## Decision path

**Jeff Miller** (chief marketing officer; Anduril's first marketing hire, May 2024) owns brand spend and
built the NASCAR and Hendrick programmes, so he is the sponsorship owner rather than Palmer Luckey.
Path: Matthew Steckman (President & Chief Business Officer), Matt Grimm (Co-Founder & COO), Brian
Schimpf (CEO); Palmer Luckey is the brand principal. No CFO is named in the sources opened.

## Screen-outs and things not claimed

- **Revenue is not used.** Pre-IPO market sites report ~$2.2B for 2025 and ~$4.3B 2026 guidance; these
  are not company disclosures and are left out of the brief.
- **No Lattice-on-the-pit-wall workstream is claimed.** TWG AI is Cadillac's primary and exclusive AI
  partner; the value section is an honest MODE B with named mechanics, and the second risk row is the
  category definition.
- **Brand safety is the first risk row**, not a footnote: a weapons maker on an F1 car will be tested by
  a European fan base and by team and promoter policies in a way NASCAR did not test. The Boeing-at-Alpine
  precedent and Cadillac's American identity are the counters; activation rules on product imagery must
  be agreed up front.
- **Team choice.** Alpine (Boeing) and Williams (Zoox) are ruled out on category; Aston Martin on the
  Aramco title; Haas is open but lacks the GM Defense path; Red Bull, Racing Bulls and the European
  heritage teams have no US identity. Cadillac was chosen on the sponsor table and the GM relationship.
- **Grid Fit panel vs. this brief.** The rendered GRID FIT panel is the pipeline's automatic category read
  (`seeds/sponsor_categories.json`), which has no defence category; trust the ruled-out list on the app
  page over the panel.
- **Deal size ($8–12M a year) is an ESTIMATE**, labelled as such.
- **Score reset from 86 to 79.** Capacity and timing are at the ceiling; brand fit and ops fit are held
  back by defence sensitivities and by the absence of a real operational workstream.
